title: Extended Content ControlInformation (ExCCI) Data Packet
scope: This document defines content protection and content management (CPCM) information in the form of an extended content control information (ExCCI) data packet, including the packet’s syntax, semantics, and structure. The packet is intended to convey redistribution control information for use as content is exported into the consumer space. Not all consumer distribution channels are expected to utilize all of the ExCCI information. (See annex B.)
